reviews.comment: Dr. Kravaris is an expert in controls. He is good about answering questions in and after class so come prepared having read the material. His office hours are very helpful, he is patient in re-explaining material. Computer project is hard so start early. Homework is challenging but reasonable. Exams are graded pretty hard but he curves at the end
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Lots of coding that he did not know how to do (relied on TA to teach hard parts). Used simple lecture examples and HW and tests were always harder. Lectures were very slow and mostly not helpful. He criticized class performance on tests, saying we needed to step up. Very difficult MATLAB group project sucked. Take someone else.

This class takes a lot of coding and you really aren't taught much of it. It felt like every homework you were doing something you didn't know yet. That said, he was a pretty good prof overall, and despite the difficulty of the problems he was really great if you went to office hours. His exams were much easier than the homework.
I honestly think that this prof is an extremely good lecturer, especially with how he has to explain a very complex topic. I really didnt think I would understand as much as I did.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class is so difficult and his lectures are difficult to follow, BUT do not fear. His homework is 10/10 difficult, but they make his tests SO easy. He clearly cares deeply for his students and want us to have an authentic understanding of the material. He's the professor you want and he wants you : )

reviews.comment: Dr. Kravaris is awesome, almost always in his office, even on weekends, and always willing to answer questions and give a lot of help with homework. Homework is usually very long and pretty difficult, but exams are easy. Overall an easier course compared to most in the department. Group project is pretty straightforward, and doesn't take too long.
